newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 20.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 20.

text.p: - All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Possible light rains expected later in the day along Baja California peninsula and much of Pacific Coast. Maximum winds of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high.
Light rains along the coast of Veracruz, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula. Moderate cold front heading toward the northwestern gulf region, expected to affect the region later in the day.
Winds at a maximum 10 to 15 knots and waves at heights of three to five feet.
Hot and partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
